senses.gloss: m.(b. h. גּוֹב, גּוֹבַי; גבה, cmp. גִּבֵּחַ) [the hump-backed,] gobay, a species of edible locusts.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 1:7:2">Y. Taan. I, end, 64ᵈ</cite> <he>שני דברים … וג׳</he> two calamities, drought and locusts. Ib. III, 66ᵈ (homiletic etymology) why is it called <cite ref="C00274"><he>גוביי</he></cite>? <he>דו גבי דינא וכ׳</he> because it collects the (fines of) judgment of the Lord.
